Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 1403/2020

Dear Mr. Ranade,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 December 2020 about your dispute with Sai Constructions. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 7,93,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
